infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Podium needs access to your photo library so you can choose an existing photo to use as your profile picture. Your photos are never shared or uploaded without your permission.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Podium uses the microphone to capture your voice when you ask questions about lessons using the voice input feature. Audio is processed for speech-to-text only and is not stored.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Podium uses speech recognition to convert your spoken questions into text when using the voice input feature during lessons. This helps you interact with lesson content hands-free.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Podium needs access to your camera so you can take a new photo to use as your profile picture. Photos are only used for your profile and are not shared publicly.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Podium uses tracking to understand how you interact with the app so we can personalize your learning experience and improve lesson recommendations based on your progress.
